descripcion: Manager, Analytics and Optimization – Client Care At Chanel, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL. About the role: CHANEL is seeking an Analytics and Optimization Manager to strengthen and scale Client Care through rigorous reporting, advanced analytics, and selective use of automation and AI. This role is grounded first and foremost in core analytics, reporting, and operational insight, while also evolving how Client Care leverages technology to work more efficiently and proactively. The role owns Client Care reporting and analytics foundations while progressively identifying where automation and AI can enhance accuracy, speed, and decision-making. AI is an enabler, not the center of gravity. What impact you can create at CHANEL: Core Reporting & Analytics Excellence (Foundational) Own recurring reporting and analytics for Client Care, including weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reporting. Deliver analysis across contact volume, contact drivers, productivity, service levels, quality, NPS, and forecasting accuracy. Define and standardize KPIs, metrics, and data definitions across channels to ensure a single, trusted source of truth. Translate performance data into clear, actionable insights for Client Care leadership and operational teams. Advanced Analytics & Insight Development Evolve reporting from descriptive to diagnostic and forward-looking insights over time. Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify root causes, trends, and opportunities for operational improvement. Support forecasting, capacity planning, and scenario modeling in partnership with Group Director, Operational Excellence. AI & Optimization Enablement Proactively identify and propose AI and optimization use cases relevant to Client Care (e.g., sentiment analysis, contact reason classification, demand forecasting, QA support, agent assist, summarization, knowledge retrieval), aligned to strategic priorities defined by the Group Director, Operational Excellence. Support evaluation and business case development for AI and automation opportunities, grounding recommendations in measurable operational impact. Partner with CHANEL Tech to support responsible piloting, testing, and implementation of approved AI capabilities. Monitor emerging AI and automation trends within contact centers and customer experience, sharing insights and recommendations for consideration within the broader roadmap. Evaluate tools and capabilities through a practical, value-driven lens, ensuring alignment with operational needs and long-term sustainability. Technology Roadmap Partnership Support execution of the Client Care analytics and insights technology roadmap, aligning day-to-day priorities with business objectives defined by the Group Director, Operational Excellence. Serve as the business lead for analytics platforms (e.g., Salesforce data, Power BI, sentiment and speech analytics tools), ensuring solutions meet operational reporting and insight needs. Gather business requirements, document use cases, and partner closely with Tech on build, testing, delivery, and adoption. Support prioritization of enhancements in alignment with roadmap direction and operational impact. Ensure data quality, usability, scalability, and long-term sustainability of analytics solutions. Drive adoption through clear documentation, stakeholder education, and change support. Self-Service Reporting & Enablement Build a self-service reporting model that enables Client Care teams to access standard reports and dashboards independently. Create clear documentation and reporting libraries so teams know where to find insights without submitting ad-hoc requests. Establish intake and prioritization processes for custom analysis, ensuring focus on high-value, strategic work. Educate stakeholders on how to interpret reports and use data effectively in decision-making. Operational & Cross-Functional Partnership Partner closely with the Group Director, Operational Excellence, to support vendor oversight, performance management, and operational reviews. Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Education, Digital, Retail, and Tech teams. Maintain strong relationships with third-party vendors to ensure reporting accuracy, transparency, and alignment. You are energized by: Building strong reporting and analytics foundations that teams can rely on. Turning data into clear, practical insights that improve operations. Improving efficiency through better processes, tools, and selective automation. Partnering across functions to solve complex operational problems. Introducing new capabilities thoughtfully and responsibly. What you will bring to the team: A strong sense of ownership and accountability for delivering high-quality, reliable analytics and insights A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to identify opportunities and drive improvements independently The ability to influence business decisions through data, connecting insights to clear operational actions Strong data storytelling skills, with the ability to tailor insights for different audiences and drive alignment A collaborative approach, building strong partnerships across Operations, Technology, and cross-functional teams Curiosity and a continuous improvement mindset, with a desire to evolve processes, tools, and ways of working A thoughtful and pragmatic approach to automation and emerging technologies, prioritizing value and business impact Attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy, consistency, and integrity Position Logistics: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; 3–5+ years in analytics, operations, or insights roles. Experience in contact center, customer care, or service operations environments. Comfort working with large datasets and translating data into operational insights. Exposure to or interest in automation and AI, with a pragmatic, business-first mindset. Ability to partner effectively with Tech teams without needing to be a technical specialist. Strong communication and change-management skills. Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce, Power BI, Excel, and performance reporting. Partially Remote: Role requires a minimum of three days in-person office presence at the designated location/office. Location requirements: Piscataway or New York Office Location Compensation: The anticipated base salary range for this position is $89,000 through $107,000. Base salary is one component of the total compensation for this position. Other forms of variable pay [may/will] be offered for this position. Other components [may/will] include bonus potential, benefits, and/or perks. descripcion: About Ticketure At Ticketure, we’re on a mission to modernize ticketing for museums, galleries, zoos, and attractions around the world. Our cloud-based, mobile-first platform empowers cultural institutions to deliver seamless, scalable, and data-driven visitor experiences. From timed-entry bookings to CRM integrations, we eliminate the limitations of outdated systems and enable our partners to operate with greater efficiency and insight. We’re redefining what ticketing software can be, combining intuitive design, flexible architecture, and powerful analytics to help organizations better understand their audiences, unlock new revenue opportunities, and expand their impact. Ticketure is built for institutions that expect more from their technology and value a true partner in growth. No matter your role, whether you’re building the platform, supporting our clients, or driving our growth, you’ll be part of a collaborative team that values innovation, ownership, and meaningful impact. If you’re excited to help organizations connect people with culture and create exceptional experiences, we’d love to meet you. What We Are Looking For We’re looking for a thoughtful, organized, and proactive People & Talent Partner who thrives in a fast-paced, growing environment. You bring a strong foundation in recruiting and people operations, with the ability to manage competing priorities while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail. You are comfortable partnering with hiring managers, guiding structured hiring processes, and creating a consistent, high-quality experience for candidates and employees alike. You have a systems-oriented mindset and enjoy improving how things work, whether that’s refining recruiting workflows, enhancing onboarding, or leveraging tools and data to drive better outcomes. You are comfortable working with modern tools and technologies, including an interest in or experience with AI-enabled tools, and understand how to thoughtfully apply them to improve efficiency while maintaining quality and integrity. You take ownership, communicate clearly, and approach your work with curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset. About You You have experience managing full-cycle recruiting and partnering effectively with hiring managers across a variety of roles. You are organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high standard of work. You are comfortable working with systems such as ATS and HRIS platforms and bring a practical, process-driven approach to improving how work gets done. You communicate clearly, build strong relationships, and are able to effectively engage candidates while conveying the company’s value and opportunity. You are passionate about your work, motivated to continue learning and growing, and take ownership of your responsibilities. You exercise sound judgment, handle sensitive information with discretion, and represent the company with professionalism in every interaction. About The Role The People & Talent Partner plays a critical role in shaping how we attract and integrate talent by owning end-to-end recruiting and onboarding, while helping build and maintain effective, scalable people processes. This role partners closely with hiring managers to execute structured hiring practices, deliver a strong candidate experience, and ensure new hires are set up for success from day one. As a primary point of contact for candidates and new employees, this role serves as a key representative of the company, shaping first impressions and reinforcing the company’s values and brand. The People & Talent Partner supports core people operations, including systems, workflows, and employee lifecycle processes. With a focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence, this role strengthens how the organization attracts, integrates, and supports talent in a fast-paced, scaling SaaS environment. This position reports directly to the Director, Human Resources. Who We Are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Libsyn is dedicated to simplifying the creative process - from publishing to distribution and monetization to measurement - enabling creators to connect with audiences on all major platforms while monetizing their efforts. Through our advertising services and technology, we’re reshaping how advertisers reach their target customers by connecting brands with their desired audience. At Libsyn, we’re on the lookout for innovative problem-solvers, collaborative thinkers, and self-starters who thrive in a fast-paced, customer-centric environment. Our team members, and our leaders, enjoy the freedom to think and act like entrepreneurs, always with our creators and advertisers top of mind. Together, we’re not just a workplace - we’re creating a supportive community that values diverse perspectives and fosters growth, empowering each other to deliver exceptional value to the podcasting world. Job Summary We are seeking a Head of Business Analytics to own Libsyn’s business analytics and performance insight. This is a senior individual contributor role responsible for defining, validating, and communicating the metrics that guide executive and operational decision-making. Libsyn’s data spans multiple internal systems and third-party vendors. This role requires comfort working in a fragmented data environment, aggregating and validating data directly from multiple sources to answer high-impact questions. This is not a backward-looking reporting role. You will deliver forward-looking analyses that support product discovery, experimentation, and roadmap decisions. Working closely with the CEO, Product Management, and functional leaders, you will frame the right questions, test assumptions, and interpret signals responsibly. This includes verifying metrics, challenging weak conclusions, and helping the organization avoid confirmation bias and misinterpretation. This is a hands-on role with no direct reports, designed for someone who thrives in ownership, influence, and execution. You are accountable for ensuring that data presented to leaders is accurate, contextualized, and decision-ready. The impact of your work will be measured by whether leaders ask better questions, make better tradeoffs, and avoid costly misinterpretations of performance signals. How You Will Make An Impact Own Libsyn’s KPI framework end to end—metric definitions, documentation, governance, and ongoing evolution. Establish and maintain a single source of truth for metrics, including a KPI dictionary and clear logic for how KPIs are calculated. Build, maintain, and continuously improve executive-level and team-level KPI reporting and dashboards that support operating rhythms (monthly/quarterly). Serve as the trusted authority on company metrics, providing clear analysis, insights, and recommendations to leadership. Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that inform product, business, and operational decisions. Partner closely with Product Managers to define measurement plans for new features and initiatives, including success metrics, baselines, targets and guardrails. titulo: Director of Category and Shopper Insights
descripcion: THE OPPORTUNITY: Hint Inc. is a leading flavored water company dedicated to delivering high-quality products to consumers throughout the US. We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly analytical leader to elevate our category insight capabilities. This role is critical in shaping our Market position, driving actionable insights, and enabling both Sales and Bran teams to make informed decisions that accelerate growth. The Director of Category and Shopper Insights will serve as the go-to category expert for both internal teams and external retail partners, translating complex data into compelling narratives, recommendations, and strategies. This role is a key member of the Customer Development team while working closely with National Accounts, Brand Marketing, and revenue Growth Management to inform execution, guide priorities and identify growth opportunities across current and adjacent categories. Key Responsibilities Own the category narrative: Transform data into compelling, actionable stores for Sales, Brand, and leadership teams. Deliver insight-led recommendations: Provide credible, forward-looking insights that shape joint business planning, assortment strategies, pricing, and promotion guidance and revenue growth initiatives. Enable Sales Excellence: Equip Sales teams with turnkey selling narratives, and dashboards to quickly act on insights and strengthen customer conversations. Support Brand Strategy: Provide Category and shopper context to refine identify whitespace opportunities. Synthesize data across sources: Consolidate syndicated data, internal sales data, shopper trends, panel metrics and market intelligence into single, actionable category point of view. Drive Cross functional alignment: Partner closely with customer development, Sales, revenue growth management, finance, and brand marketing to ensure consistent execution and strategy alignment. Advance category expertise: Serve as the internal expert, guiding decisions, and strategy as the business defends space and expands into adjacent categories. Develop tools and frameworks: Improve and create reporting and analytical tools that allow teams to extrapolate insights efficiently, enhancing execution at national, regional, and channel levels. Communication to influence: Prense complex analyses and recommendations clearly to leadership and retail partners. Requirements Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or a related field (MBA preferred). 7+ years of experience in Category Management, Category Insights, or Shopper Insights within the CPG or beverage industry. Strong understanding of category management, shopper behavior, and retail market analysis. Experience using syndicated data tools such as SPINS, IRI/Circana, Numerator, and Kroger Stratum/84.51°. Advanced Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, IF statements, SUMIFS). Strong PowerPoint and data storytelling skills to turn data into clear insights and recommendations. Experience supporting sales teams, customer development, and joint business planning with retail partners. Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and selling stories. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and ability to influence teams without direct authority. Highly organized and able to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Benefits Base salary of $100,000-115,000. Actual salary offer may vary based on location and work experience. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future Bonus Eligible Unlimited Vacation Sick Days Up to 95% of the employee and dependent healthcare premiums paid for by the company Life insurance (company-paid and voluntary) Flexible Spending Accounts 401K (regular and Roth) Up to $150/month health and wellness reimbursement Up to $100 monthly towards your cell phone and $50 monthly towards Internet (if applicable) Employee Discount on Hint Water Show more Show less

titulo: Analista de Control de Gestión de La Planta Procesadora de Aves / Samborombóm Prov. Bs As (Buenos Aires)
descripcion: En ADN - Recursos Humanos estamos en la búsqueda de Analista de Control de Gestión de la Planta Procesadora de Aves / Samborombóm Prov. Bs As para Importante Empresa. Requerimientos: - Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería en Alimentos, Contabilidad o afines. - Conocimiento en control de gestión, análisis de datos y gestión de KPIs en un entorno de producción. - Familiaridad con el uso de herramientas de ERP y BI (Business Intelligence) para la gestión y análisis de datos. - Conocimiento de los procesos de faena de aves y normativas de calidad y seguridad alimentaria. - Habilidades analíticas y capacidad para identificar problemas y proponer soluciones eficaces. - Experiência en la mejora continua de procesos productivos. - Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión y cumplir con los plazos establecidos. - Excluyente contar con movilidad propia. Misión del puesto: - El Analista de Control de Gestión de la Planta Procesadora de Aves es responsable del seguimiento, control y análisis de los KPIs clave del proceso de faena y procesamiento de aves, con el objetivo de optimizar la producción, reducir la mortandad y asegurar la eficiencia operativa en la planta. El puesto implica proporcionar soporte analítico y estratégico para la mejora continua, reducir costos y aumentar la productividad, siempre manteniendo el cumplimiento de las normativas de calidad y seguridad. Tareas a desarrollar: - Monitoreo y análisis de KPIs: Elaborar, monitorear y analizar indicadores clave como la mortandad de aves, rendimiento de faena, producción por turno, tiempos de ciclo de faena, costos de procesamiento y eficiencia operativa. - Control y seguimiento de la producción: Asegurar que el volumen de aves procesadas y el rendimiento de la planta estén alineados con los objetivos de producción. Identificar desvíos y establecer acciones correctivas. - Análisis de mortalidad: Realizar un análisis detallado de la mortandad de aves, identificar las causas raíz y proponer planes de acción para mitigar los riesgos y optimizar la tasa de supervivencia. - Gestión de costos: Controlar los costos operativos de la planta, incluyendo los costos asociados al procesamiento, mano de obra, materiales y subproductos. Elaborar informes periódicos de costos y proponer medidas para mejorar la rentabilidad. - Programación y control de faena: Supervisar la programación diaria y semanal de la faena, asegurando que se cumplan las metas de procesamiento de aves y minimizando las interrupciones en la producción. - Monitoreo de calidad: Colaborar con el área de control de calidad para asegurar que el procesamiento cumpla con los estándares de calidad e higiene requeridos, generando reportes de incidencias y proponiendo mejoras. - Informe de desempeño y propuestas de mejora: Preparar informes periódicos sobre los resultados de producción, indicadores de mortandad y otros KPIs principal, presentando propuestas de mejora para optimizar el rendimiento de la planta. Gestión de inventarios: Realizar el seguimiento y control del inventario de productos semi-elaborados y terminados, asegurando que los níveles de inventario sean los adecuados y que no haya desperdicios innecesarios. - Mejora continua de procesos: Identificar y proponer mejoras en los procesos de faena y procesamiento, con el objetivo de aumentar la eficiencia operativa, reducir pérdidas y optimizar los recursos. Lugar de trabajo: Samborombóm, provincia de Buenos Aires - Argentina Lugar de residencia: Preferentemente cerca del lugar de trabajo. Horario: Lunes a viernes de 8 a 17 hs. Job Description: MedReview is seeking a talented Data Scientist/ Analyst to join our team and help build a robust, scalable feature store. This individual will bridge the gap between data analysis, feature engineering, and MLOps, ensuring that features for machine learning models are discoverable, consistent, and readily available for both training and real-time serving. The ideal candidate is organized, self-motivated, and able to work in an environment which is dynamic, with a global workforce and a rapidly expanding business. This position will sit in Austin, Texas. However, for the right fit, we may consider remote . Key Responsibilities: Feature Store Development & Management : Collaborate with ML engineers and data platform teams to design, implement, and maintain the feature store architecture for both offline (batch) and online (real-time) use cases. Feature Engineering & Analysis : Identify, define, and engineer high-quality features from various raw data sources (databases, APIs, streaming data) using statistical analysis and domain knowledge. Collaboration & Governance : Partner with database administrators, clinical experts, data scientists, ML engineers, and business stakeholders to promote feature reuse, define governance standards, track feature lineage, and ensure data consistency across models. Data Pipeline Integration : Build and optimize ingestion and transformation pipelines using distributed data frameworks to populate the feature store, ensuring data accuracy, reliability, and freshness. Model Support : Generate training and testing datasets from the feature store and work with ML engineers to ensure seamless feature serving for model inference in production environments. Monitoring & Quality Assurance : Develop monitoring and alerting frameworks to track feature data quality, integrity, and latency, proactively identifying and resolving issues.
